nodes.description: uint256 public maxBears, maximum NFT supply set in constructor
uint constant public MAX_BEARS_MINT = 51, batch mint cap
bool public saleIsActive, gate for minting functions
uint256 public startingIndex, pseudorandom reveal offset
uint256 public startingIndexBlock, block used as randomness seed
uint256 public setBlockTimestamp, timestamp threshold for seeding
uint256 public revealTimestamp, timestamp gate for reveal
string public BearProvenance, provenance hash storage
string private baseURI used by _baseURI
BOTB private botb, external NFT contract referenced for ownership checks
constructor(name, symbol, maxNftSupply, botbContractAddress, saleStart) initializes supply, botb and reveal timestamps
public mintBear(uint256) validates BOTB ownership via external call then _safeMint to msg.sender
public mintNBears(uint256[]) batch mint looping over external balanceOf/ownerOf calls and _safeMint
public setStartingIndex() derives startingIndex from blockhash and block.timestamp gate
private trySetStartingIndexBlock() captures block.number when timestamp/supply condition met
public onlyOwner emergencySetStartingIndexBlock() resets startingIndexBlock
public onlyOwner setRevealTimestamp(uint256) writes revealTimestamp
public onlyOwner setStartingBlockTimestamp(uint256) writes setBlockTimestamp
public onlyOwner setProvenanceHash(string) writes BearProvenance
public onlyOwner flipSaleState() toggles saleIsActive
public onlyOwner setBaseURI(string) writes baseURI
external view isMinted(uint256) bounds-checks tokenId and returns _exists
internal view override _baseURI() returns baseURI state variable
internal _safeMint(to, tokenId) mints and invokes ERC721Receiver callback on recipient
caller controlled address used for ownership/balance checks and mint recipient
miner-influenced timestamp used for reveal and seed timing gates
external call to botb.ownerOf() on an attacker-influenced token id in mint flows
external call to botb.balanceOf(msg.sender) in batch mint loop
_safeMint executes control transfer to recipient via onERC721Received enabling reentrancy
blockhash(startingIndexBlock) / blockhash(block.number-1) used for pseudorandom startingIndex
uint256 botbTokenId parameter of mintBear used for ownership check and minted id
uint256[] tokenIds parameter of mintNBears iterated for batch mint
uint length = tokenIds.length local in mintNBears
uint balance = botb.balanceOf(msg.sender) local in mintNBears
uint tokenId = tokenIds[i] local in mintNBears loop
uint i loop counter in mintNBears batch loop
